scripts.build: npm run build -w @gitscribe/core && npm run build -w @gitscribe/extension && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @gitscribe/core && npm run test -w @gitscribe/extension && npm run test:mcp
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.publish:npm:dry: npm run build:npm && npm publish -w @gitscribe/core --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @gitscribe/mcp --access public --dry-run
scripts.publish:npm: npm run build:npm && npm test && npm publish -w @gitscribe/core --access public && npm publish -w @gitscribe/mcp --access public
